# EEVSEC CyberRange

> A competitive, live-fire cybersecurity training arena: real-time PvP battles on isolated virtual machines, a state-aware AI Coach, and deep attack/defense simulations. Currently in pre-launch; the waitlist is open. Operated by EEVSEC PRIVATE LIMITED (Ahmedabad, India).

## Core
- [How it works](https://eevsec.com/#how): Two players enter one live scenario, one attacks and one defends, across isolated virtual machines.
- [AI Coach](https://eevsec.com/#coach): Side-aware, in-match guidance that tracks your actions and explains the next move; each side's session is private.
- [Modes](https://eevsec.com/#modes): Battle, Practice, Learn, and Analyze.
- [Scenarios](https://eevsec.com/#scenarios): IoT & semiconductor, digital forensics, cloud & zero-trust, adversarial AI, red/blue automation, and SCADA/ICS.
- [Doctrine](https://eevsec.com/doctrine.html): Every scenario runs on three layers — WAR (strategy), Ethical Hacking (craft), and Cyber Crime (the real-world threat).
